description: Defines a template class PacketNumberIndexedQueue for managing a queue of packet entries indexed by packet number, supporting insertion, removal, and retrieval operations with internal circular deque storage.

classes.name: PacketNumberIndexedQueue
classes.description: A specialized queue for packet entries indexed by packet number, supporting efficient insertion, removal, and access, optimized for ordered packet processing in QUIC.

methods.name: GetEntry
methods.description: Retrieves the entry associated with a specific packet number, returning nullptr if not found.

methods.name: Emplace
methods.description: Inserts a new entry with a given packet number and arguments, only if insertion order is maintained.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes the entry associated with a specific packet number, optionally calling a provided function before removal.

methods.name: RemoveUpTo
methods.description: Removes all entries up to a specified packet number.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the queue is empty.

methods.name: number_of_present_entries
methods.description: Returns the count of current entries in the queue.

methods.name: entry_slots_used
methods.description: Returns the number of allocated slots in the underlying deque.

methods.name: first_packet
methods.description: Returns the packet number of the first entry in the queue.

methods.name: last_packet
methods.description: Returns the packet number of the last inserted entry, or 0 if empty.
